## Houlihan Lokey Continues Rapid Expansion of Direct Equity Product Team


November 18, 2026


**Chen Na Joins the Firm’s Equity Capital Solutions Practice as a Managing Director in New York**


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Chen Na has joined the firm’s Capital Solutions Group as a Managing Director. Ms. Na is based in New York and will serve as a senior financial professional on the Equity Capital Solutions team, focused on leading direct equity transactions.


Ms. Na joins following a 15-year career at Stifel, where she was most recently a Managing Director and Head of Technology M&A. While at Stifel, Ms. Na was instrumental in building out that firm’s U.S. Technology M&A practice, originating and executing M&A transactions across a number of technology verticals, including tech-enabled services, software, and hardware and electronics. She began her career at Thomas Weisel Partners in 2006.


Matt Swain, Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Solutions at Houlihan Lokey, commented, “The strong similarities between a traditional M&A process and a direct equity transaction, both of which center on the acquisition of a single asset, make Chen an ideal candidate to bring her extensive M&A advisory expertise to our direct equity product team. I have no doubt that her considerable talents will be invaluable to our clients as we continue to grow our Equity Capital Solutions platform.”


Anthony Martino, Global Co-Head of Capital Solutions, said, “Deep sector expertise has been a hallmark of Houlihan Lokey’s corporate finance strategy for decades, and we have been extremely successful at embedding financial professionals who possess both sector knowledge and execution expertise within our Capital Solutions Group. This combination translates into a meaningful enhancement of client service and, ultimately, superior results for both our funded and independent sponsor clients seeking direct equity investment opportunities. Chen is exactly the type of individual to continue to deliver those results and maintain our dominant position in direct equity.”


Ms. Na said, “Houlihan Lokey’s corporate culture, unmatched breadth and depth of relationships among financial sponsors, and comprehensive slate of services make for an incredibly exciting chance to help establish the best direct equity product platform in financial services. The consolidating and rapidly changing technology landscape has added meaningful complexity to many private equity portfolios, and our clients are actively trying to understand, manage, and/or act opportunistically. We believe that offering the full landscape of private financing alternatives, including direct equity, will differentiate Houlihan Lokey. I am excited to help our clients identify attractive opportunities for directs in technology to execute M&A in this challenging environment.”


Houlihan Lokey’s Capital Solutions Group comprises more than 240 dedicated professionals across 18 offices in eight countries, including Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas, Dubai, Frankfurt, Houston, London, Los Angeles, Madrid, Manchester, Milan, Munich, New York, Paris, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., West Palm Beach, and Zurich. In the past 12 months, the group raised and advised on $42 billion across more than 140 transactions.*


*As of September 30, 2026.


**About Houlihan Lokey**


Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
